topic: Flat cash back paid in full vs chasing points on a balance (Nolan vs Delphine)

scenes.narration: Chasing rewards cost him nine hundred dollars in interest. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding two clipboards labeled CHASE POINTS and BANK CASH BACK, comic burst banner reads NINE HUNDRED IN INTEREST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nolan and Delphine each spend two thousand dollars monthly on cards.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man nolan and woman delphine holding identical cards, a chalkboard stamped TWO THOUSAND A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both signed up for rewards cards in the very same week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan and delphine at a gym sign up desk, a banner reads REWARDS CARDS, both holding new cards, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nolan chases points, adding purchases to hit signup bonus targets.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan sprinting on a treadmill after a floating points icon, a bonus target sign labeled SPEND MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He carries a balance at twenty two percent to keep spending.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan straining under a heavy weight plate stamped TWENTY TWO PERCENT APR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Delphine takes flat two percent cash back on normal spending only.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, delphine calmly tapping a card stamped TWO PERCENT CASH BACK at a gym smoothie counter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She pays the statement balance in full every single month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, delphine stamping a statement PAID IN FULL at a gym desk, a wall calendar of green checkmarks, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her cash back sweeps automatically into a high yield savings account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an arrow carrying coins from delphine's card into a gym locker labeled HIGH YIELD SAVINGS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nolan earned six hundred in points but paid nine hundred interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nolan on a gym scale, one side stamped SIX HUNDRED POINTS the other NINE HUNDRED INTEREST tipping down, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Delphine banked four hundred eighty dollars cash and zero interest charges.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, delphine flexing beside a gym scoreboard reading FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY CASH and ZERO INTEREST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two years later her rewards account holds nearly one thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, delphine opening a gym locker stuffed with bills, a tag reads NEARLY ONE THOUSAND, calendar stamped TWO YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rewards only count if you pay the balance in full. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading PAY IN FULL OR NO REWARDS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
